hook: Magnetar 1E 2259+586 spun down abruptly in 2025 as its X-ray flux doubled.

readout.label: Persistent X-ray flux increase after anti-glitch

summary: X-ray data from EP, NICER and IXPE show a 2025 anti-glitch in the magnetar 1E 2259+586, its largest, with a fractional frequency change near -8.19e-7. Unlike its 2019 event, the persistent flux rose by about 106% and took over 320 days to recover, with a gamma-ray burst nearby in time. The claim that fractional amplitudes grow monotonically rests on very few events.
title: A large radiatively loud anti-glitch in 1E 2259+586 with a protracted recovery
